export const MESSAGES: Record<Locale, Messages> = { en, zh }

// A locale from a language name or tag, as Claude Code's `language` setting, LANG or Intl give
// it ("chinese", "简体中文", "zh_CN.UTF-8", "en-US"); null when it names none we speak.
export function localeOf(value: string | undefined | null): Locale | null {
  const v = String(value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase()
  if (v === '' || v === 'c' || v === 'posix') return null
  if (/^zh|chinese|中文|汉语|漢語/.test(v)) return 'zh'
  if (/^en|english/.test(v)) return 'en'
  return null
}

{
  "name": "token-almanac",
  "displayName": "Token Almanac",
  "version": "0.6.1",
  "description": "Session and machine-wide token usage, plan limit meters with reset countdowns, and an estimate of how long each limit lasts, fitted to your own history.",
  "author": {
    "name": "CookPiu",
    "url": "https://github.com/CookPiu"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/CookPiu/token-almanac",
  "repository": "https://github.com/CookPiu/token-almanac",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/CookPiu/token-almanac#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/CookPiu/token-almanac/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/CookPiu/token-almanac/blob/main/PRIVACY.md",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "usage",
    "tokens",
    "rate-limits",
    "quota",
    "cost",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then LANG, then the system locale",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "en",
        "zh"
      ]
    },
    "nodePath": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Node.js",
      "description": "The Node.js 18+ that reads transcript history: a command on PATH or a full path",
      "default": "node"
    },
    "motion": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Motion",
      "description": "on lets meters and charts glide to new values and a spinner turn while scanning; off draws them still",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    }
  }
}
